flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/CPS/form/CPSForm.tsx (confirmation modal + submit); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/{ChangeOfProcessingController (POST /v1/change-processing-stage), ChangeOfProcessingService.processBatch/processNotice/updateVonStage/syncCpsFieldsToInternetDb, EligibilityService}; ocmsadminprivateapi crons that read next_processing_stage (DataHiveUenFinService, MhaNricDataHelper, ToppanUploadHelper) and cron-schedules-prod.properties. thirdpartyapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui: not relevant
note: Story status: Demo paid (50% of 75%). The staff portal (CPS) flow saves the stage change and writes last/prev/next stage on VON, so a notice can move back (revert) or forward (escalate). What the repo cannot prove: that the notice is really processed automatically from the new stage according to Appendix B of Annex 1A. Appendix B is not in the repo; Toppan letter generation only runs through the manual trigger (the call in executeDayEndJobs is commented out) and the DataHive UEN/FIN cron is switched off in prod. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-170 (admin fee only at RR3/DR3), OCMS-DF-2026-097 (payment_acceptance_allowed must not become Y for AN flag), OCMS-SR-2026-107 (surcharge at court stages), all Closed and already visible in the code.
recommendation: Claim the save part (VON update, amount recalculation, eVON sync, audit). The 'processed automatically from the new stage' part is only Sebagian: ask URA/team which cron counts as the Appendix B workflow and whether it is active on the server

steps.step: Officer confirms on the CPS page and the UI submits the stage change to OCMS
steps.detail: onConfirmation first validates via POST change-processing-stage/validate, then shows the 'CPS Confirmation' modal (CPSForm.tsx:163-171); once the officer agrees proceedCPS triggers onSubmit, which POSTs to change-processing-stage with the X-User-Id header (CPSForm.tsx:212-225, 328-335).

steps.step: OCMS processes each notice, warns when a change already exists today, and checks eligibility before saving
steps.detail: processBatch calls processNotice per item (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:88-106). processNotice returns WARNING when a record exists today without isConfirmation (:955-972) and calls eligibilityService.checkEligibility; a non-changeable result becomes FAILED (:975-985). The content of the eligibility rules is judged in other stories.

steps.step: OCMS moves the notice to the new stage (revert or escalate): prev, last and next stage and their dates are rewritten
steps.detail: updateVonStage(von, newStage, true): prev = old last, last = new stage, then the manual branch sets next_processing_stage = new stage and next_processing_date = now (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1104-1115), then vonService.save (:1035-1036). There is no stage-order comparison, so both backward and forward moves work. The Javadoc above the method (next taken from the NEXT_STAGE parameter) differs from the manual branch; the code uses the manual branch.

steps.step: Derived data follows the new stage: amount payable, admin fee, surcharge, payment flag, sync to Internet DB (eVON) and an audit record
steps.detail: calculateAmountPayable from composition_amount, admin fee via applyAdministrationFeeForStage (OCMS-DF-2026-170), payment_acceptance_allowed = Y unless an_flag = Y (OCMS-DF-2026-097), surcharge for CPC/CSD/CSR/COS/COM (OCMS-SR-2026-107) (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1006-1024). syncCpsFieldsToInternetDb copies to eVON immediately (:1041, :1191-1221); if the Internet DB fails it only logs and the sync cron reconciles later (:1219). Audit row in ocms_change_of_processing (:1048-1061). The story does not mention these, so they are supporting only.

steps.step: The notice is then processed automatically from the new stage following the automated workflow in Appendix B of Annex 1A
steps.detail: The written next_processing_stage/date values are read by crons: DataHiveUenFinService selects next_processing_stage IN (RD1,RD2,RR3,DN1,DN2,DR3) and next_processing_date <= today (DataHiveUenFinService.java:235-236), MhaNricDataHelper uses the same condition (:34). But cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, and Toppan letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters because the executeJob() call in executeDayEndJobs is commented out (addendum fact), although cron.toppanupload.enabled=true (:61-62). The content of Appendix B is not in the repo. The real server property values: cannot verify from repo.
